name: Anytouch
body:
This Touch of Loss can emulate the effect of almost any other Touch of Loss

Requirement: Ghoul HD 17

Effect: The ghoul can use this touch to emulate the effect of any other touch of loss up to 15th Hit Die. If it already knew that touch, then it applies the improved loss of that touch if it is a touch of up to 11th Hit Die. If it already knew the improved loss of that touch, then it applies the gain and loss of that touch if it is a touch of up to 7th Hit Die. If it already had the gain and loss of that touch, then the Save DC against the effect becomes 4 points higher if the touch is of up to 3rd Hit Die.
